verdict.detail: Discogs lists 5 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
This is the original UK release in matt cover, on Vertigo 'spaceship' labels, with '1Y//1, MELY.' and '2Y//2, MELS!' runouts.
Includes a double sized folded lyrics/photo insert.
Poly-lined 'Plastic Bags Can Be Dangerous' standard inner sleeve with 'British Patent No. 800513 & 973939', 'Made In England' and '4913 000 15801'. 
Some copies may include an additional large fold-out poster, which was intended for advertising in record shops. [see images]

Recorded Spring 1974 at IBC Studios, London, England.

℗ 1974 Phonogram Ltd.

Phonogram Limited • Stanhope House • Stanhope Place • London W2 2HH
Printed in England by Robert Stace
Made in England

Published by Shawbury Music/Valley Music, except B2, B4: Valley Music.

There is a very similar release here

with a side B label variant.

Runouts are stamped, except for etched '9102001', 'MELY.' and 'MELS!'.
In variant 1 side B, the last digit '13' is mirrored.
